clips.title: The story
paras: Raptor Ridge rises above the eastern Wetlands, northwest of the Dragonmaw Gates. Razormaw raptors hunt and nest among its crags, with a vicious matriarch deep in the caverns.

Razormaw raptors hunt in packs across Raptor Ridge, where rocky trails climb above the eastern Wetlands. Travelers near the foothills of Khaz Modan risk meeting these predators. In a cavern at the ridge's heart, the Razormaw Matriarch guards her brood and nests from intruders. The Dragonmaw Gates lie close by.
